# stalwart_metrics (Data Source)

Configures metrics collection and export via OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `metrics` (Set of String) List of metrics to include or exclude based on filter mode
- `metrics_policy` (String) How to interpret the metrics list
- `open_telemetry` (Attributes) OpenTelemetry metrics configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_telemetry))
- `prometheus` (Attributes) Prometheus metrics endpoint configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prometheus))

<a id="nestedatt--open_telemetry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open_telemetry`

Read-Only:

- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint for Open Telemetry
- `http_auth` (Attributes) The type of HTTP authentication to use (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_telemetry--http_auth))
- `http_headers` (Map of String) Additional headers to include in HTTP requests
- `interval` (Number) The minimum amount of time that must pass between each push request to the OpenTelemetry endpoint
- `timeout` (Number) Maximum amount of time that Stalwart will wait for a response from the OpenTelemetry endpoint
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

<a id="nestedatt--open_telemetry--http_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open_telemetry.http_auth`

Read-Only:

- `bearer_token` (Attributes) Bearer token for HTTP Bearer Authentication (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_telemetry--http_auth--bearer_token))
- `secret` (Attributes) Password for HTTP Basic Authentication (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_telemetry--http_auth--secret))
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `username` (String) Username for HTTP Basic Authentication

<a id="nestedatt--open_telemetry--http_auth--bearer_token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open_telemetry.http_auth.bearer_token`

Read-Only:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from


<a id="nestedatt--open_telemetry--http_auth--secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open_telemetry.http_auth.secret`

Read-Only:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from




<a id="nestedatt--prometheus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prometheus`

Read-Only:

- `auth_secret` (Attributes) The Prometheus endpoint's secret for Basic authentication (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prometheus--auth_secret))
- `auth_username` (String) The Prometheus endpoint's username for Basic authentication
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

<a id="nestedatt--prometheus--auth_secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prometheus.auth_secret`

Read-Only:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from
